text: Nine full lessons, one single real project, all building toward the same finished dashboard. It genuinely starts right here, with no Power BI screen at all in sight — just a vague ask that has to become something actually buildable first.

The VP of Sales at Adventure Works Cycles wants, in their own words, something that shows how we're doing. Applying Chapter Eight's audience-first thinking directly to that vague request turns it into four specific, real requirements: regional performance, product-line profitability, reseller fulfillment, and trend over time compared to last year.

Every single one of those four requirements maps cleanly onto real tables already sitting inside AdventureWorksDW2014 — this is the exact list Lesson 85 goes on to actually import next, nothing added and nothing missing.

A real scope means saying clearly what's genuinely out, just as much as what's actually in. This particular project stays deliberately USD-only, AdventureWorksDW2014-only, and desktop-viewing-only — every one of those boundaries chosen on purpose, specifically so the project stays realistically finishable.

A written scope like this is exactly what you'll check the finished dashboard against, all the way at the end in Lesson 93. Lesson 85 starts the actual hands-on build itself: importing the real raw data for the very first time.
